{{Quote|Mission accomplished. The N-1 assembly site is now under our control.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] after fighting off [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The '''N-1 assembly site''' was a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] used to construct the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Security Force's]] [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]]. The assembly site was attacked during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
The site consisted of the assembly buildings, a command post, and a runway where completed [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] waited for their [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. The whole complex was situated in the northern frozen mountains of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
Prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the base was taken over by [[Borvo]] the Hutt and his [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire]]. When the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaded Naboo in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] moved quickly to secure all points of resistance.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> The assembly site was quickly blockaded and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who ran the facility was cut off. The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], in disarray from the invasion, sent two [[Security Officer]]s to find a way to fight the Droid Army. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|rescued]] the smuggler, a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named [[Borvo]]. The pilots escorted him and his [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|freighter]] to the site. They fought through [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to the assembly site. In response, the Droid Army attempted to raze the site. The pilots, assisted by [[Kol Kotha|one of the Hutt's pilots]], commenced strafing runs against the Federation [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tanks]], saving the facility.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Though the immediate threat had been taken care of, and the assembly site had taken heavy damage, surviving N-1s rested on the landing strip. The pilots switched their vehicles for the new starfighters and took off to [[Attack on disabled base|to strike back]] at the Trade Federation forces.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
This facility appeared in a mission in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
